findings.title: Post-agent credential snapshots harvest needles from agent session/transcript files under /root/.gemini, causing false credential_bytes failures
findings.fix: Fix the credential file set at snapshot #1; #2a/#2 re-read only those paths plus credential-named new files outside tmp/logs/history/brain/conversations/cache; whole-file needles only from files <= 8 KiB; add §9 item 14 and a unit test with a transcript file.

findings.title: Credential snapshot 1 MiB member / 8 MiB total limits drop data silently
findings.fix: Count skipped members and append one non-failing violation event; bound the stream with _ChunkReader(64 MiB); unit cases.

findings.title: Untrusted .git/config check 2 has no rule for git config exit codes other than 0/1 (malformed config)
findings.fix: exit 0 + output -> UnsafeGitConfig; exit 1 or empty -> OK; any other exit -> UnsafeGitConfig('could not be parsed'); unit case.

findings.title: App port 443 or 3128 collides with proxy listeners; not validated
findings.fix: resolve_policy(..., app_port) raises EgressConfigError at step 1 for 443/3128 in non-off modes; unit cases.

findings.title: §8.2 test 6 stale vs D9 (image-git core.worktree claim), capture path unspecified, tracked-symlink fixture missing
findings.fix: Shared _run_trusted_step8 helper for tests 6/7; reword vector (2); add served_repo_with_tracked_symlink fixture; fix §1 row.

findings.title: GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL needs git >= 2.32 but gate is 2.29
5-base/5c GitCaptureError message claims an Event_Log that does not exist
findings.fix: Append the Event_Log suffix only if the file exists.

findings.title: Untrusted-config spool must be a one-member tar for put_archive
findings.fix: Specify a PAX tar with member untrusted-config, 0644, uid/gid 0.

findings.title: Violation payload host spelling unspecified; lowercased host defeats case-sensitive scrub
findings.fix: Log raw_host and use it (sanitised) in payloads; scrub test.

findings.title: vaultshield teardown cannot find the random-suffix proxy staging dir
findings.fix: Glob vaultshield-egress-<id>-* in tempdir and rmtree.

findings.title: FR5 symlink wording and NFR1 off-mode call list contradict the detailed design
findings.fix: Reword FR5 to added/retargeted links; list Sandbox get_archive and kill() in NFR1.
